videos.script: Ask ten people what software quality means, and most of them say: no bugs. {{no-bugs}} Then picture a ticket shop with no bugs at all, that takes four minutes to sell one ticket. Nobody calls that good. {{slow-shop}} So quality is more than the absence of defects. This lesson gives the word three meanings, and each one points you somewhere different. {{three}} Conforming to what was written. Being fit for what people use it for. And value, to somebody who matters. {{definitions}} Then it splits the product into nine characteristics, from correctness to safety, so that good becomes something you can check. {{nine}} And it turns to the other half. Not the thing that was made, but the way it was made. {{process}} At Cine Aurora, every change was reviewed. The age defect was reviewed too, and it went through. {{review}} The process was followed. It simply never looked at the place where the mistake was. {{end}}
